title: Boss 2: Why Are Leads So Expensive?
description: Your biggest client's CPL has ballooned from ₹85 to ₹290. The CEO is on the phone questioning your skills. Diagnose the account over 6 surgical steps to restore profitability and defeat Boss 2!

steps.title: Step 1: Check Technical Health & Events Manager
steps.context: Before touching any ad copy, you inspect Events Manager. The 'Lead' event shows a warning badge.
steps.question: What is the very first diagnostic check in Events Manager?
options: Delete the pixel and reinstall it
Verify event match quality and test standard event firing with the Meta Pixel Helper to confirm leads are actually recording
Change the ad account billing currency to US Dollars
Ignore the warning and blame the sales team
steps.explain: Always confirm tracking health first. If pixel events stop firing or double-fire, all dashboard metrics become untrustworthy.
steps.hint: Check if conversions are actually reaching Meta's servers.

steps.title: Step 2: Inspect Frequency & Creative Fatigue
steps.context: Tracking is verified healthy. You open the Ad Set dashboard and look at Frequency over the last 14 days.
steps.question: What does this frequency data reveal about Ad Set 1?
options: Ad Set 1 is performing brilliantly because people love seeing ads 5 times
Ad Set 1 is suffering from severe creative fatigue: users have seen the same ad over 5 times, driving up CPM and tanking CTR
Frequency 5.12 means 5 people clicked the ad
Nothing is wrong
steps.explain: A frequency over 5.0 on a cold audience means everyone has seen the ad multiple times and is now tuning it out.
steps.hint: What happens to people when they see the exact same ad 5 times?

steps.title: Step 3: Audience Overlap Audit
steps.context: You check Meta's Audience Overlap tool between Ad Set 1 and a third retargeting ad set in the account.
steps.question: The tool shows 68% audience overlap between the two ad sets. What is the consequence?
options: Meta gives you a 68% discount on clicks
Your own ad sets are entering the ad auction bidding against each other, unnecessarily inflating your own CPM
Leads will automatically convert on WhatsApp
Your ads will run on Google search
steps.explain: High audience overlap causes self-competition in auctions, driving up your own CPMs.
steps.hint: Are your own campaigns competing for the same customers?

steps.title: Step 4: Landing Page Speed & Conversion Rate
steps.context: You test the landing page on Google PageSpeed Insights on a 4G mobile connection. The load time is 6.8 seconds.
steps.question: How does a 6.8-second mobile load time impact your campaign's Cost Per Lead?
options: It has zero impact because Meta users are very patient
Over 50% of visitors abandon the page before it loads, causing high CPC/CPM to translate into terrible conversion rates and sky-high CPL
Slow load times improve SEO rankings
Meta speeds up the page automatically
steps.explain: Every second of mobile loading latency causes a ~20% drop in conversions. Reducing load time to 1.5s cuts drop-offs in half.
steps.hint: Do you wait 7 seconds for a website to open on your phone?

steps.title: Step 5: The Offer & Form Friction
steps.context: The lead form currently requires 8 manual input fields: Full Name, Email, Phone, Company, Designation, Annual Turnover, GST Number, and City.
steps.question: What is the recommended optimization to remove form friction?
options: Add 5 more questions to make it even more thorough
Streamline the form to 3 essential fields (Name, Phone, City), and ask downstream qualification questions over the sales call or WhatsApp
Remove the phone number field
Ask for their home address and Aadhaar card
steps.explain: Friction kills form conversion. Keep initial lead capture short and gather deeper details on the phone or via WhatsApp.
steps.hint: Fewer mandatory fields = higher completion rate.

steps.title: Step 6: Executing the Recovery Plan
steps.context: You have identified all the leaks. What is the comprehensive recovery roadmap you execute today?
options: Delete the entire ad account and start fresh with a new Facebook page

1. Pause fatigued Ad Set 1; 2. Consolidate overlapping audiences; 3. Compress landing page images to hit <2s load time; 4. Reduce form fields to 3 essential questions; 5. Deploy 3 fresh video hook variations.
Triple the daily budget to ₹15,000 to overpower the auction
Do nothing and tell the CEO to wait 6 months
steps.explain: This 5-point action plan addresses tracking, creative fatigue, audience self-competition, page speed, and form conversion simultaneously.
steps.hint: Combine fixes across creative, audience, and landing page.
